en_title: As Resident Evil Requiem Passes $500m Revenue, Analysis Shows 8.6% Sales Were on Xbox, With Remaining 91% Shared Between PS5 and Steam
subtitle: 平台差距悬殊
opus_summary: Alinea Analytics分析显示，《生化危机：安魂曲》售出850万份，其中XBOX版约73.1万份，占8.6%；PS5版占48.1%，Steam版占43.4%。人民币换算待核实。

paragraphs.en: Resident Evil Requiem sold just 8.6% of its copies on Xbox, new sales analysis indicates.
paragraphs.cn: 最新销量分析显示，《生化危机：安魂曲》的销量中，XBOX版仅占8.6%。

paragraphs.en: Data published today by Alinea Analytics revealed the eye-opening split in platform sales for this year's brilliant Resident Evil game, offering yet another glimpse into Xbox's struggles against its rival, Sony's dominant PlayStation 5.
paragraphs.cn: Alinea Analytics今天公布的数据揭示了这款出色的《生化危机》新作在各平台上悬殊的销量差距，也再次反映出XBOX面对竞争对手索尼旗下占据优势的PS5时所处的困境。

paragraphs.en: Requiem is still selling faster than any other game in Capcom's survival horror series so far and has now passed $500 million in total revenue, with 8.5 million copies shifted across PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S. But only 8.6% of that 8.5 million (around 731,000 copies) were sold for Xbox consoles.
paragraphs.cn: 《生化危机：安魂曲》仍是卡普空这部生存恐怖系列迄今销售速度最快的作品，总收入现已超过5亿美元(约合人民币34亿元)；人民币换算金额尚待核实。游戏在PC、PS5和XBOX Series平台共售出850万份，但其中XBOX版仅占8.6%，约73.1万份。

paragraphs.en: Compare that to the whopping 48.1% of copies sold on PS5 (around 4.01 million) and the relatively similar 43.4% of copies sold via Steam (around 3.69 million) and it's clear how far behind Xbox is here.
paragraphs.cn: 相比之下，PS5版占总销量的48.1%，约401万份；Steam版的占比也达到43.4%，约369万份。XBOX版落后多少，一目了然。

paragraphs.en: On the one hand, this isn't a huge surprise. PS5 has sold well this console generation, with 95.3 million units shipped as of June. Six years into its lifecycle and with hardware prices on the rise, sales momentum has notably slowed. But the machine is guaranteed to get a shot in the arm this fall when GTA 6 arrives, and PS5 is exclusively plastered all over the game's marketing.
paragraphs.cn: 一方面，这并不太令人意外。PS5在这一代主机中卖得不错，截至6月出货量已达9,530万台。上市六年后，随着硬件价格上涨，其销售势头已明显放缓。不过，随着《GTA6》在今年秋季推出，PS5肯定会迎来一波提振；这款游戏的宣传材料中，出现的主机平台只有PS5。

paragraphs.en: Xbox Series X/S, on the other hand, has really struggled. Microsoft stopped reporting sales figures years ago, though its current pair of consoles are believed to have sold a little over 35 million units to date — a figure that's worryingly below the unpopular Xbox One, which shifted 58 million units during the last console generation.
paragraphs.cn: 另一方面，XBOX Series的处境确实艰难。微软多年前就停止公布主机销量，不过据估计，这两款现役主机迄今合计售出略多于3,500万台。这个数字甚至远低于上一代并不受欢迎的XBOX One，后者售出了5,800万台，令人担忧。

paragraphs.en: Today's data on Resident Evil Requiem sales comes just a day after report pointed to a similarly significant sales split for GTA 6 preorders. The Verge 's Tom Warren stated that pre-sales for Rockstar's upcoming blockbuster were "heavily skewed" towards PS5, something that had set off "alarm bells" within Microsoft's Redmond campus.
paragraphs.cn: 《生化危机：安魂曲》的这组销量数据公布前一天，有报道称《GTA6》的预购量也呈现出类似的显著平台差距。《The Verge》的Tom Warren表示，Rockstar这款即将推出的大作，其预购量「严重偏向」PS5，并在微软位于雷德蒙德的园区内敲响了「警钟」。

paragraphs.en: In a statement shared with IGN , Xbox chief strategy office Matthew Ball responded to this claim by stating that, actually, Microsoft was "very happy with GTA 6 preorders," which were "breaking records for Xbox" and "matching our share of the console market." Exactly which records were being broken, though, Ball did not elaborate.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX首席战略官Matthew Ball在发给IGN的声明中回应称，实际上，微软对《GTA6》的预购情况「非常满意」：预购量「打破了XBOX的纪录」，而且「与我们在主机市场的份额相符」。不过，Ball没有具体说明打破的是哪些纪录。

paragraphs.en: Of course, no-one should expect a 50:50 sales split for Resident Evil Requiem or GTA 6 preorders across Sony and Microsoft's consoles. PS5 has clearly outsold Xbox Series X/S this generation by some margin, and no one at Xbox is trying to pretend otherwise. Still, what Ball appears to be suggesting — that GTA 6's pre-sales split simply represents the reality of the hardware situation — does not appear to hold up with Requiem sales, where Xbox can be seen lagging behind PS5 far more than its believed hardware sales might suggest.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，没人会期待《生化危机：安魂曲》的销量或《GTA6》的预购量在索尼与微软的主机之间各占一半。这一代PS5的销量显然大幅领先XBOX Series，XBOX方面也没人试图否认这一点。不过，Ball似乎是在说，《GTA6》的预购量差距不过是两边主机销量差距的反映。但《生化危机：安魂曲》的数据似乎不支持这种解释：XBOX版与PS5版的销量差距，远大于据估计的两边主机销量差距所能解释的程度。

paragraphs.en: There's likely a number of reasons for this, and it's fair to suggest that Resident Evil is a long-lived franchise that has historically enjoyed more of a home on PlayStation consoles than Xbox, particularly in the series' homeland of Japan, where Xbox has never gained a proper sales foothold. But it's hard to look at just how far behind Requiem's Xbox sales split is and draw anything positive from it for Xbox. Are people who actually have an Xbox Series X/S now leaving it behind to play on PC or another console? Can these fans be tempted back next console generation, when Microsoft is believed to be launching a machine that can also play games from third-party PC storefronts? Whatever the case, this is another concerning sign as the company struggles through a huge reorganization aimed at ensuring its survival .
paragraphs.cn: 造成这一差距的原因可能不止一个。《生化危机》是个历史悠久的系列，长期以来在PlayStation主机上比在XBOX上更受欢迎；尤其是在系列的发源地日本，XBOX始终未能站稳脚跟。不过，看到《生化危机：安魂曲》XBOX版落后如此之多，实在很难从中找到对XBOX有利的迹象。已经拥有XBOX Series的玩家，是否正放下主机，转而在PC或其他主机上玩游戏？据称，微软将在下一代推出一款也能运行第三方PC商店游戏的主机；届时还能吸引这些玩家回来吗？无论如何，微软正艰难推进旨在确保其生存的大规模重组，而这又是一个令人担忧的信号。
